angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 501,878 km at 126.77 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.8880 +/- 0.0152 mas (same row, RUWE 1.11): 126.77 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.7214 +/- 0.0021 solar radii from Hartman et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HATS-72 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..173H/abstract): 501,878 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.7311 +/- 0.0028 solar masses from Hartman et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HATS-72 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..173H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4656.1 +/- 8.9 K from Hartman et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HATS-72 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..173H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hartman et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HATS-72 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..173H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hats-72.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.586, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HATS-72 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.099 dex, from Hartman et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..173H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HATS-72 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.65896, from Hartman et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..173H/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HATS-72 (pscomppars): age 12.17 Gyr, from Hartman et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..173H/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HATS-72 (pscomppars): rotation period 48.725 d, from Hartman et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..173H/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HATS-72 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.8 km/s, from Hartman et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..173H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
